recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed unless a future PA decision changes name search semantics for Person or RelatedPerson.
issue_request: FHIR-26371 is a Published/Persuasive PA change request asking to add given and family search parameters to Person and RelatedPerson for consistency with Patient and Practitioner.
initial_application: The request was implemented by d0af353aa415cab7ab9800ceceb66976c6280993, which added Person-family, Person-given, RelatedPerson-family, and RelatedPerson-given to the resource search-parameter bundle sources, and was merged by ddfd8d4c08e94207e6d2a3952265df2b7bdeb8cc in PR #1278.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists person and relatedperson as active resources and assigns both to PA, so the inspected search-parameter bundles are current build-scope source. Later search-parameter refactors preserved the four requested codes and FHIRPath expressions. PA May 2021 WGM minutes align with Jira by recording a persuasive disposition with a 13/0/0 vote, and no later relevant Zulip or Jira reversal was found.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. Current source defines Person-family on Person.name.family, Person-given on Person.name.given, RelatedPerson-family on RelatedPerson.name.family, and RelatedPerson-given on RelatedPerson.name.given.
